name: Computer Science Engineering
description: The CSE department focuses on software, algorithms, and computing.

name: Information Technology
description: IT focuses on application development, web, and networks.
fullDescription: Information Technology trains students in software applications, web technologies, networking, and cybersecurity.

name: Electronics & Communication
description: ECE handles electronics, signal processing, and communication.
fullDescription: Electronics & Communication Engineering covers circuits, signal processing, embedded systems, and wireless communication.

name: Civil Engineering
